svg.aria-label: Infographic. Left: C4 to E4, letters C, D, E make a third; four hops across C, C sharp, D, D sharp, E equal four semitones, a major third (M3), amber. Right: E4 to G4, letters E, F, G make a third; three hops across E, F, F sharp, G equal three semitones, a minor third (m3), violet. Same interval number, different size.
svg.title: Same letters, different size: major vs minor third
